licence.alternative_publisher_label: Publisher's Kaggle card says CC0; equivalence of the bytes has not been verified. This workflow relies on the official HF ODbL label.
licence.redistribution: No external data or resulting models are cleared for release by this experiment. Retain attribution and database licence; review database/contents/model obligations before redistribution. Sgurr's proprietary licence does not relicense the data.

provenance.position_origin: Stockfish self-play from openings it usually gets wrong (targeted, not representative of arbitrary chess positions)

search_limit.evidence: filename and Stockfish training-dataset history; original complete generator command unavailable

provenance.result_semantics: Stored -1/0/+1 loss/draw/win for side to move. Generator final outcomes may include adjudication; exact settings for this artifact are unknown.
provenance.preexisting_filters: Targeted opening selection; exact generator filters, adjudication thresholds and subsequent filtering unknown.

format.name: Stockfish binpack
format.framing: BINP + little-endian u32 payload size; independent compression chunks, not guaranteed whole games
format.scores: Signed-to-unsigned mapped big-endian 16-bit stem scores; delta-compressed continuation scores. Side-to-move perspective, native Stockfish search Value units, not assumed modern normalized UCI centipawns.
format.plain: Official converter: fen/move/score/ply/result/e. ASCII decimal scores; -1/0/+1 results remain side-to-move relative.
format.sgurr: 32 bytes, little-endian occupancy a1=0; ascending occupied squares, low nibble first, PNBRQKpnbrqk=0..11; stm 0 white/1 black; i16 mapped Sgurr cp; result source+1; four zero padding bytes

expansion.estimate_basis: Official tools README says approximately 2-3 compressed bytes/position for generated data. Estimate only; full expansion is deliberately not performed.
expansion.pilot: Eight complete chunks selected by seeded hash across the entire verified artifact. Exact compressed/expanded/filtered sizes are measured in the conversion manifest; never expand the entire artifact implicitly.

converter.boundary: Unmodified source in ignored cache, standalone converter executable invoked as subprocess. No linking or source incorporation into Sgurr; no Stockfish net download or runtime dependency.

transformations: Verify whole-file SHA-256, index every compression chunk, choose smallest seeded SHA-256 priorities without reading a biased prefix.
Official converter with validate, then independent FEN/move/kings validation and Sgurr record round-trip.
Reject malformed input; filter in-check, capture/promotion best moves, early plies and extreme mapped scores explicitly.
Drop repeated piece-placement+side-to-move keys within the selected sample deterministically; report duplicates. This is Sgurr feature equivalence, not full chess-state equivalence.
Map teacher raw score to round(raw_score*400/teacher_sigmoid_scale) Sgurr cp. Keep output/runtime scale 400. Record scale in every conversion and run.
No train/validation split for this artifact: original game IDs are not available. Stored outcomes are diagnostic only; pilot lambda=1.
